page: Amazon Web Services c8ib.24xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the AWS Nitro System. Powered by Intel x86_64 processors operating at a clock speed of 3.9 GHz, this 8th-generation instance offers 96 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 48 physical cores with two threads per core. Memory capacity is configured at 192.0 GB, establishing a standard 1:2 compute-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

Networking capabilities include a 100 Gbps baseline bandwidth, providing substantial network throughput suitable for distributed and communication-heavy environments. The instance does not include bundled local storage, requiring network-attached storage solutions for persistent data management. It also operates without hardware accelerators, featuring zero GPUs, and includes no complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Designed for scale-out parallel tasks and compute-bound processing, the hardware allocation delivers high per-core processor density. The lack of local storage shifts I/O reliance onto the high-speed network fabric. The instance is suited for high-performance computing (HPC), batch data processing, distributed compilation, video encoding, and compute-intensive scientific modeling.
